subject: Civic Education
competence: Appreciates the diversity in the world of work
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the diversity of world of work.
Explains that there are many employment opportunities available in the diversity of world of work

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Introduce the concept of world of work and its diversity
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Listen to the teacher's explanation and take notes

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Facilitate student group work to identify jobs related to different fields
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Participate in group discussions and identify jobs
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitor group progress and correct misconceptions

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Guide student presentations and structuring findings
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Present group outcomes and compare notes

summary: Recap of key findings and core principles
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Summative check or exit questions addressing all learning outcomes
